notes: Amounts are in thousands of dollars. Spending totals count General, special, bond and federal funds, including infrastructure/capital outlay, from ebudget "expenditures by fund" (rwaCntl). Reimbursements (payments between departments, already counted where the money originates) and nongovernmental cost funds (e.g. UC/CSU own funds, CalPERS/CalSTRS trust funds, local property tax revenues, disability insurance) are not spending: they are kept out of every total and reported separately (excluded). ebudget's "all funds" figure includes them.

Fund 0201 Medical Providers Interim Payment Fund (Health Care Services) is also kept out of spending ("loan-financed interim payments"): ebudget classes it as a federal fund, but its money is loans from the General Fund and Federal Trust Fund (Gov. Code 16531.1) and its expenditures are moved to the regular Budget Act items once the budget is enacted (DOF Manual of State Funds, fund 0201), so DOF Schedule 9 does not count it in any fund type.

Where the ebudget expenditures-by-fund API (rwaCntl) disagrees with the department's printed "Detail of Appropriations and Adjustments", the printed figure is used: 9889: fund 1029 API -5324029/-3370962/0 replaced by printed Detail of Appropriations -5324029/-3870962/0.

Validation (budget year): sum of departments, all funds $793.667B vs. official ebudget statistics $793.667B (diff 0K); state funds (GF+special+bond) $351.710B vs. $351.710B (diff 0K); General Fund $251.477B vs. $251.477B; special funds $95.129B vs. $95.129B; bond funds $5.104B vs. $5.104B.
ebudget's General Fund summary (sankey) reports General Fund expenditures of $251.5B and revenues/transfers of $226.8B (rounded, millions).

"Statewide" items without a department page (e.g. general obligation bond debt service, Augmentation for Employee Compensation, Supplemental Pension Payments, Proposition 98 reconciliation) are included as departments flagged extra.statewideItem; some carry negative amounts.

Subprogram/element, appropriation-item, category/object and fund-condition detail is parsed from the official department detail PDFs; where a printed fund total (Detail of Appropriations) differs from the API, the printed figure is used (see above); other PDF-vs-API differences keep the API figure for totals and show the difference as an explicit residual node. 11 reconciliation messages (see data-raw/2026-27/e/exp-validation.json).
Revenues: Amounts are in thousands of dollars, as printed in DOF Summary Schedule 8 (Enacted, Enacted on June 29, 2026).

Revenues: Schedule 8 covers only state funds: the General Fund and special funds. Bond fund proceeds and federal funds are not state revenues and are not in this tree; they appear in flows.json (measured by Schedule 9 expenditures).

Revenues: "Transfers and Loans" are net movements between the General Fund and special funds (incl. transfers to the Budget Stabilization Account); they are negative for the General Fund in some years. Treemap-style views should treat negative nodes separately.

Revenues: Special-fund revenue sources are broken down by fund using the departmental Fund Condition Statements published with the budget; "Other / not itemized by fund" holds any remainder vs. Schedule 8.
Revenues: Ids: rev/{general|special}/{major|minor|transfers}[/{minor subcategory slug}]/{7-digit revenue code}[/{4-digit fund code}].
Revenues: Per-fund itemization covers 90,806M of special-fund revenues in 2026-27; 612M is not itemized by fund (5 sources carry a residual node).

Reconciliation: 2025-26 general funds: explorer $245,298,604K vs. DOF Schedule 9 $245,302,935K (official statewide total), difference −$4,331K — 1996 General Obligation Bonds-BCS +$3,048K (DOF Summary Schedule 9 — Comparative Statement of Expenditures p. 4); 3340 California Conservation Corps −$6,396K (3340 department budget detail — Summary of Projects p. 7; DOF Summary Schedule 9 — Comparative Statement of Expenditures p. 6); 8570 Department of Food and Agriculture −$983K (8570 department budget detail — Summary of Projects p. 15; 8570 department budget detail — Detail of Appropriations — capital outlay p. 16; DOF Summary Schedule 9 — Comparative Statement of Expenditures p. 14).
